//: Copy to plugins.local.json (gitignored) or use ./try-plugin.sh, then ./setup-demo.sh or ./run-ui.sh --restart. Same entries as config.json "packages": a spec string, or { "source", "config" }; relative local paths are relative to this repo. Entries with only a "//" key are comments. See README.md "Trying your own plugins".

A persona package ("mpt": { "personas": ["personas/*.md"] }) is an entry like any other — a local folder, git URL or npm spec, no config, no build: e.g. "~/src/my-team-personas". Its personas appear on Config → Personas as <package name>/<id>; select one per source on Config → Sources (persona / triage persona). The fixture already loads ./plugins/mpt-personas-demo. A triage-mode source must have a triage persona: one that declares none (MPTSimWorkSources' triage source) gets builtin:triage on its first start — pick a better one on Config → Sources (e.g. mpt-personas-demo/tracker-triager).

MPTSimWorkSources (Taskei + SIM-T): run brazil-build in the package first. Replace the placeholders, or leave config out and set it up on Config → Sources (Preview, then Save; copy a keeper back here).
